challenge.better_approach: Alternatives: have every drafter write commons refs bare ('.gitattributes'), which is ambiguous with a cairn-root file of the same name (both repos have .gitattributes), so the prefixed spelling is the only unambiguous one; or route ref_exists through look()'s fixed resolver, which couples grammar to the rehearsal tool. The one-line extra try in _ref_exists is the smallest.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That root's parent is where the commons sits, which _ref_exists already assumes on its next line (commons = dirname(root)/CairnCommons); this only stops doubling the name.
challenge.prior_art: look() fixed the same CairnCommons/CairnCommons doubling under ticket 7a31059daa23 (open-118b21c2f226, answered). hollow._commons_rel already accepts CairnCommons/<rel>. No ticket covers grammar._ref_exists (grep of tickets and questions on 2026-11-16).
challenge.real_collision: None: a ref that resolved before still resolves (the new try only adds). A ref that should not resolve, a missing commons file, still does not.

answers.falsifier: Done when ref_exists('CairnCommons/.gitattributes') is True on a box whose commons carries it and 3f2692580b2f's survey passes; wrong intent if some caller relies on CairnCommons/<rel> being unresolvable (none found: grep of callers).
answers.how: In _ref_exists, beside the existing <commons>/<ref> try, also try <dirname(root)>/<ref> when the ref's first path part is 'CairnCommons'. A red-first proof in cairn/tools/chain/proofs calls ref_exists against a scratch root pair for CairnCommons/.gitattributes and CairnCommons/tickets/_charter+why.json, and checks the spellings that already resolve still do and a missing commons file still does not.
answers.shape: aside — it blocks 3f2692580b2f's BUILDME at survey_holdings_resolve
answers.traces_to: Law 3 (the survey judge reports a real commons file as not in the world) and Law 1 (the same fault was already fixed in look(), ticket 7a31059daa23; one resolution rule, two mouths).
answers.what: grammar.ref_exists resolves a ref spelled from the commons' own name (CairnCommons/<rel>) under the commons, so a survey holding at a commons file resolves.

bullets.text: survey_holdings_resolve refused a real commons file because ref_exists doubles the CairnCommons segment.

title: grammar.ref_exists resolves a ref spelled from the commons' own name (CairnCommons/<rel>) under the commons, so a survey
